rules.name: Unique LMC Item Id
rules.description: Each LMC item's `id` must be unique within the file when present. SEVAL itself does not require uniqueness, but duplicate ids silently break downstream joins (LMC item ↔ QuerySet row ↔ judgement output) for any consumer that keys by `id`. The check is case-sensitive (UUID/GUID style ids); items without an `id` (e.g. TagElement entries) are skipped.

metadata.expression: all `id` values present in the LMC array must be unique

rules.name: Unique LMC Tag Name
rules.description: Each `TagElement.tag` must be unique within the file. Tag-name collisions silently break the tag-resolution graph used by cross-file matching (rules 1.B.1 / 1.B.2 / 1.B.3). The check is case-insensitive; QueryElement items without a `tag` field are skipped.

metadata.expression: all `tag` values present in the LMC array must be unique (case-insensitive)
